topic.angle: Not all eggs in one basket

body.claim: Diversification lowers risk because asset prices don't all move in step.
body.why: If prices don't change in perfect synchrony, a diversified portfolio varies less than the average of its parts. A single stock dropping 50% in a year is not unusual, but a portfolio of 20 stocks falls that far less often. It is the same idea as the proverb about eggs and baskets.

probes.question: Why does holding many different assets reduce risk?
options: Prices don't all move in step

probes.question: True or false: holding only one stock is an example of an undiversified portfolio.
